ex.r: ni1 geoi3 hai6 mat1 je5 ji3 si1
ex.en: What does this sentence mean?

note: Also used casually to address a shop owner or waiter.

ex.r: ngo5 lou5 sai3 gam1 jat6 m4 hai2 dou6
ex.en: My boss isn't in today.

ex.r: lou5 sai3 maai4 daan1
ex.en: Boss, the check please!

ex.r: gaan1 pou3 ge3 lou5 sai3 hou2 hou2 jan4
ex.en: The shop owner is really nice.

note: Borrow from = 問…借; lend to = 借…俾.

ex.s: 可唔可以借支筆嚟用吓？
ex.r: ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 ze3 zi1 bat1 lai4 jung6 haa5
ex.en: Can I borrow a pen?

ex.r: ngo5 ze3 zo2 bun2 syu1 bei2 keoi5
ex.en: I lent him a book.

ex.r: ngo5 soeng2 man6 ngan4 hong4 ze3 cin2 maai5 lau2
ex.en: I want to borrow money from the bank to buy a flat.

en: to give (a gift); to see off, take

ex.r: ngo5 sung3 zo2 tiu4 geng2 gan1 bei2 keoi5
ex.en: I gave her a scarf as a gift.

ex.r: ngo5 sung3 nei5 faan1 uk1 kei2 laa1
ex.en: I'll take you home.

ex.r: maai5 loeng5 go3 sung3 jat1 go3
ex.en: Buy two, get one free.

ex.r: nei5 gam1 go3 hok6 kei4 sing4 zik1 dim2 aa3
ex.en: How are your grades this semester?

ex.r: keoi5 sing4 zik1 hou2 hou2
ex.en: She gets great grades.

ex.r: gung1 si1 gam1 nin2 ge3 sing4 zik1 m4 co3
ex.en: The company had good results this year.

ex.r: ngo5 haau2 leoi6 haa5 sin1
ex.en: Let me think about it.

ex.r: nei5 jau5 mou5 haau2 leoi6 gwo3 bun1 uk1
ex.en: Have you ever thought about moving?

ex.r: keoi5 haau2 leoi6 gan2 zyun3 gung1
ex.en: He's thinking about changing jobs.

note: 普通話 = Mandarin.

ex.r: di1 je5 sik6 hou2 pou2 tung1
ex.en: The food was just okay.

ex.r: ngo5 dei6 zi2 hai6 pou2 tung1 pang4 jau5
ex.en: We're just friends.

ex.r: ngo5 jiu3 jat1 gaan1 pou2 tung1 fong2 zau6 dak1
ex.en: A standard room is fine for me.

ex.r: hai2 uk1 kei2 hou2 mou4 liu4 aa3
ex.en: I'm so bored at home.

ex.r: ni1 go3 wui2 hou2 mou4 liu4
ex.en: This meeting is so boring.

ex.r: m4 hou2 gong2 maai4 di1 mou4 liu4 je5 laa1
ex.en: Stop talking nonsense.

ex.r: keoi5 gam1 jat6 hou2 kei4 gwaai3
ex.en: He's acting weird today.

ex.r: ni1 bui1 je5 jam2 jau5 di1 kei4 gwaai3 mei6
ex.en: This drink tastes a bit strange.

ex.s: 部手機發出好奇怪嘅聲。
ex.r: bou6 sau2 gei1 faat3 ceot1 hou2 kei4 gwaai3 ge3 seng1
ex.en: My phone is making a weird sound.

note: 對…有信心 = be confident about…

ex.s: 我對呢次考試好有信心。
ex.r: ngo5 deoi3 ni1 ci3 haau2 si5 hou2 jau5 seon3 sam1
ex.en: I'm confident about this exam.

ex.r: keoi5 gong2 jing1 man2 mou5 mat1 seon3 sam1
ex.en: She isn't very confident speaking English.

ex.r: ngo5 deoi3 san1 tung4 si6 hou2 jau5 seon3 sam1
ex.en: I have a lot of faith in our new coworker.

en: to fall; to drop; to lose (something)

ex.r: siu2 sam1 di1 m4 hou2 dit3 can1
ex.en: Be careful, don't fall.

ex.r: ngo5 dit3 zo2 ngan4 baau1
ex.en: I lost my wallet.

ex.r: di1 lau4 gaa3 dit3 zo2
ex.en: Property prices have dropped.

note: As a noun = ticket: 戲飛 (movie), 機飛 (plane).

ex.r: zek3 zoek3 fei1 zo2 jap6 uk1
ex.en: A bird flew into the house.

ex.r: ngo5 ting1 jat6 fei1 heoi3 toi4 waan1
ex.en: I'm flying to Taiwan tomorrow.

ex.r: ngo5 maai5 zo2 loeng5 zoeng1 hei3 fei1
ex.en: I bought two movie tickets.

ex.r: nei5 gei2 si4 bat1 jip6 aa3
ex.en: When do you graduate?

ex.r: ngo5 bat1 jip6 zo2 saam1 nin4 laa3
ex.en: I graduated three years ago.

ex.r: keoi5 jat1 bat1 jip6 zau6 wan2 dou2 gung1
ex.en: She found a job right after graduating.

ex.r: ni1 go3 wing6 ci4 hou2 sam1
ex.en: This pool is really deep.

ex.r: jau5 mou5 sam1 sik1 di1 ge3
ex.en: Do you have it in a darker color?

ex.r: ni1 bun2 syu1 hou2 sam1 ngo5 tai2 m4 ming4
ex.en: This book is hard, I can't understand it.

ex.r: gam1 ci3 ngo5 ceng2
ex.en: This time it's on me.

ex.r: gam1 ci3 haau2 si5 hou2 naan4
ex.en: This exam was hard.

ex.s: 今次去旅行我想去海邊。
ex.r: gam1 ci3 heoi3 leoi5 hang4 ngo5 soeng2 heoi3 hoi2 bin1
ex.en: On this trip I want to go to the beach.

note: Teaching as a profession; 教 alone = teach someone something.

ex.r: ngo5 lou5 po4 hai2 siu2 hok6 gaau3 syu1
ex.en: My wife teaches at a primary school.

ex.r: gaau3 syu1 hou2 san1 fu2 gaa3
ex.en: Teaching is hard work.

ex.r: nei5 dim2 gaai2 soeng2 gaau3 syu1 aa3
ex.en: Why do you want to be a teacher?

note: Measure word 隻; a pair is 對.

ex.r: haang4 dou3 ngo5 deoi3 goek3 hou2 tung3
ex.en: I've walked so much my feet hurt.

ex.r: ngo5 zek3 goek3 nau2 can1
ex.en: I twisted my foot.

ex.r: zoeng1 toi2 jau5 jat1 zek3 goek3 laan6 zo2
ex.en: One leg of the table is broken.

note: Usually followed by 都. Very colloquial.

ex.r: ngo5 bat1 lau1 dou1 zung1 ji3 sik6 laat6
ex.en: I've always liked spicy food.

ex.r: keoi5 bat1 lau1 dou1 ci4 dou3
ex.en: He's always late.

ex.r: hoeng1 gong2 bat1 lau1 dou1 gam3 gwai3
ex.en: Hong Kong has always been this expensive.

note: For flat pieces: cake, bread, towels. Dollars are 蚊, not 塊.

ex.r: nei5 jiu3 m4 jiu3 sik6 faai3 daan6 gou1
ex.en: Do you want a piece of cake?

ex.r: ngo5 soeng2 jiu3 loeng5 faai3 do1 si2
ex.en: I'd like two slices of toast.

ex.r: bong1 ngo5 lo2 faai3 mou4 gan1
ex.en: Get me a towel.

note: For cars, buses, planes and some machines.

ex.r: gaa3 baa1 si2 gei2 dim2 dou3 aa3
ex.en: What time does the bus arrive?

ex.r: keoi5 maai5 zo2 gaa3 san1 ce1
ex.en: He bought a new car.

ex.r: ngo5 uk1 kei2 gaa3 sai2 ji1 gei1 waai6 zo2
ex.en: My washing machine at home broke.

en: to clap, pat; to film; 拍拖 = to date

ex.r: daai6 gaa1 jat1 cai4 paak3 sau2
ex.en: Everyone, clap together!

ex.r: keoi5 paak3 zo2 tiu4 pin2 bei2 ngo5 tai2
ex.en: He filmed a video and showed it to me.

ex.r: keoi5 dei6 paak3 zo2 to1 saam1 nin4
ex.en: They've been dating for three years.

en: to be willing to; to agree to
note: 唔肯 = refuse.

ex.r: keoi5 m4 hang2 sik6 coi3
ex.en: He refuses to eat vegetables.

ex.r: lou5 sai3 hang2 bei2 ngo5 fong3 gaa3
ex.en: My boss agreed to give me time off.

ex.r: nei5 hang2 m4 hang2 tung4 ngo5 heoi3
ex.en: Will you go with me?

en: to change; to correct; to alter

ex.r: ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 goi2 si4 gaan3 aa3
ex.en: Can we change the time?

ex.r: tiu4 fu3 taai3 coeng4 jiu3 goi2 dyun2 di1
ex.en: The pants are too long, they need shortening.

ex.r: lou5 si1 bong1 ngo5 goi2 gung1 fo3
ex.en: The teacher corrects my homework.

note: 抵食 = good value food; 唔抵 = not worth it.

ex.r: ni1 go3 tou3 caan1 hou2 dai2
ex.en: This set meal is great value.

ex.r: jat1 baak3 man1 saam1 gin6 hou2 dai2 aa3
ex.en: Three for a hundred dollars, what a deal!

ex.s: 坐咁耐飛機去兩日，唔抵。
ex.r: co5 gam3 noi6 fei1 gei1 heoi3 loeng5 jat6 m4 dai2
ex.en: Flying that long for two days isn't worth it.

note: Same meaning as 原本.

ex.s: 我本來想去，但係要返工。
ex.r: ngo5 bun2 loi4 soeng2 heoi3 daan6 hai6 jiu3 faan1 gung1
ex.en: I originally wanted to go, but I have to work.

ex.r: keoi5 bun2 loi4 zyu6 hai2 soeng6 hoi2
ex.en: She originally lived in Shanghai.

ex.r: gin6 saam1 bun2 loi4 hai6 baak6 sik1 gaa3
ex.en: The shirt was originally white.

ex.r: hoi1 tau4 ngo5 m4 sik1 gong2 gwong2 dung1 waa2
ex.en: At first I couldn't speak Cantonese.

ex.r: tou3 hei3 hoi1 tau4 hou2 mun6
ex.en: The start of the movie was boring.

ex.r: fan6 gung1 hoi1 tau4 hou2 san1 fu2
ex.en: The job was tough at the beginning.

ex.r: nei5 zoeng1 loi4 soeng2 zou6 me1
ex.en: What do you want to do in the future?

ex.r: ngo5 dei6 zoeng1 loi4 soeng2 hai2 hoeng1 gong2 zyu6
ex.en: Someday we'd like to live in Hong Kong.

ex.r: cou5 di1 cin2 bei2 zoeng1 loi4 jung6
ex.en: Save some money for the future.

en: to save (up); to collect; to store
note: Spoken cou5; dictionary reading cyu5.

ex.r: ngo5 cou5 gan2 cin2 heoi3 leoi5 hang4
ex.en: I'm saving money for a trip.

ex.r: keoi5 zung1 ji3 cou5 jau4 piu3
ex.en: He likes collecting stamps.

ex.r: bou6 sau2 gei1 mou5 wai2 cou5 soeng2 laa3
ex.en: My phone has no space left for photos.

ex.r: nei5 go3 hyut3 aat3 zing3 soeng4
ex.en: Your blood pressure is normal.

ex.s: 第一次學係咁㗎，好正常。
ex.r: dai6 jat1 ci3 hok6 hai6 gam2 gaa3 hou2 zing3 soeng4
ex.en: That's how it is when you first learn, totally normal.

ex.r: gam1 jat6 di1 ce1 hou2 do1 m4 zing3 soeng4
ex.en: There's so much traffic today, it's not normal.

note: Often just 易 in speech: 好易.

ex.r: ni1 go3 zi6 hou2 jung4 ji6 se2
ex.en: This character is easy to write.

ex.s: 喺香港搵工容易唔容易？
ex.r: hai2 hoeng1 gong2 wan2 gung1 jung4 ji6 m4 jung4 ji6
ex.en: Is it easy to find a job in Hong Kong?

ex.r: dung1 tin1 hou2 jung4 ji6 beng6
ex.en: It's easy to get sick in winter.

en: could it be that…? don't tell me…
note: Starts a surprised or rhetorical question; often ends with 咩.

ex.r: m4 tung1 nei5 m4 gei3 dak1 zo2
ex.en: Don't tell me you forgot?

ex.r: keoi5 zung6 mei6 dou3 m4 tung1 sak1 ce1
ex.en: He's still not here, could he be stuck in traffic?

ex.r: m4 tung1 ngo5 jiu3 seng4 jat6 dang2 nei5 me1
ex.en: Am I supposed to wait for you all day?

note: Measure word 條. 識路 = know the way.

ex.r: ni1 tiu4 lou6 hou2 sak1 ce1
ex.en: This road always has bad traffic.

ex.r: ngo5 m4 sik1 lou6 nei5 daai3 ngo5 heoi3 laa1
ex.en: I don't know the way, take me there.

ex.r: lok6 jyu5 lou6 waat6 siu2 sam1 di1
ex.en: The roads are slippery in the rain, be careful.

ex.r: ngo5 ting1 jat6 haau2 si5
ex.en: I have an exam tomorrow.

ex.r: haau2 si5 cin4 jat1 maan5 ngo5 fan3 m4 zoek6
ex.en: I couldn't sleep the night before the exam.

ex.r: ngo5 jiu3 haau2 si5 sin1 ho2 ji5 sing1 zik1
ex.en: I have to pass an exam before I can be promoted.

note: Cantonese 'stand'; Mandarin uses 站.

ex.r: baa1 si2 mou5 wai2 jiu3 kei5
ex.en: There are no seats on the bus, so I have to stand.

ex.r: kei5 hai2 dou6 m4 hou2 juk1
ex.en: Stand there and don't move.

ex.r: ngo5 kei5 zo2 seng4 jat6 deoi3 goek3 hou2 gui6
ex.en: I stood all day, my feet are so tired.

note: 壞咗 = broken / spoiled.

ex.r: bou6 laang5 hei3 gei1 waai6 zo2
ex.en: The air conditioner broke.

ex.r: keoi5 m4 hai6 waai6 jan4
ex.en: He's not a bad person.

ex.r: di1 ngau4 naai5 waai6 zo2 m4 hou2 jam2
ex.en: The milk has gone bad, don't drink it.

en: to make a mistake; to get wrong
note: 有冇搞錯！ = are you kidding me! (annoyed)

ex.r: m4 hou2 ji3 si1 ngo5 gaau2 co3 zo2
ex.en: Sorry, I made a mistake.

ex.r: nei5 gaau2 co3 zo2 zoeng1 daan1 aa3
ex.en: You got the bill wrong.

ex.s: 我搞錯日子，聽日先考試。
ex.r: ngo5 gaau2 co3 jat6 zi2 ting1 jat6 sin1 haau2 si5
ex.en: I got the date wrong, the exam isn't until tomorrow.

ex.s: 我個女讀緊小學三年級。
ex.r: ngo5 go3 neoi2 duk6 gan2 siu2 hok6 saam1 nin4 kap1
ex.en: My daughter is in third grade.

ex.r: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 siu2 hok6 ge3 lou5 si1
ex.en: She was my elementary school teacher.

ex.r: uk1 kei2 fu6 gan6 jau5 gaan1 siu2 hok6
ex.en: There's an elementary school near my home.

ex.en: Are you American?

ex.r: ni1 dou6 hai6 m4 hai6 paai4 deoi2 aa3
ex.en: Is this the line?

ex.r: nei5 hai6 m4 hai6 m4 syu1 fuk6 aa3
ex.en: Are you not feeling well?

ex.en: She jumped up with joy.

ex.r: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 tiu3 mou5 laa1
ex.en: Let's go dancing!

ex.r: zek3 gau2 tiu3 zo2 soeng5 cong4
ex.en: The dog jumped onto the bed.

note: Spoken shortcut: 百五 = 150.

ex.r: ni1 deoi3 haai4 saam1 baak3 man1
ex.en: These shoes are 300 dollars.

ex.r: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 jau5 gei2 baak3 jan4
ex.en: Our company has a few hundred people.

ex.r: haau2 si5 ngo5 lo2 zo2 jat1 baak3 fan1
ex.en: I got 100 on the exam!

ex.r: ngo5 co5 zung1 gaan1 laa1
ex.en: I'll sit in the middle.

ex.s: 間舖喺銀行同超市中間。
ex.r: gaan1 pou3 hai2 ngan4 hong4 tung4 ciu1 si5 zung1 gaan1
ex.en: The shop is between the bank and the supermarket.

ex.r: tou3 hei3 zung1 gaan1 ngo5 fan3 zoek6 zo2
ex.en: I fell asleep in the middle of the movie.

ex.r: nei5 sik1 m4 sik1 gong2 zung1 man2 aa3
ex.en: Can you speak Chinese?

ex.r: ngo5 mui5 maan5 dou1 hok6 zung1 man2
ex.en: I study Chinese every night.

ex.r: jau5 mou5 zung1 man2 caan1 paai2 aa3
ex.en: Is there a Chinese menu?

ex.r: gei1 piu3 jiu3 ng5 cin1 man1
ex.en: The plane ticket costs 5,000 dollars.

ex.r: ni1 tiu4 cyun1 jau5 gei2 cin1 jan4 zyu6
ex.en: A few thousand people live in this village.

ex.r: ngo5 gam1 jat6 haang4 zo2 baat3 cin1 bou6
ex.en: I walked 8,000 steps today.

note: Measure word 部.

ex.r: sik6 faan6 m4 hou2 tai2 din6 si6
ex.en: Don't watch TV while eating.

ex.r: zau2 dim3 gaan1 fong2 mou5 din6 si6
ex.en: The hotel room has no TV.

ex.r: cam4 maan5 din6 si6 bo3 zo2 tou3 hou2 hei3
ex.en: There was a good movie on TV last night.
